title: German Cottage Pie
description: A hearty German-inspired twist on the classic cottage pie, featuring a rich mushroom gravy and a creamy topping.
instructions: Sauté the sliced mushrooms in butter until tender.
In a separate pan, combine the crumbled cottage cheese and all-purpose flour.
Gradually add in the beef broth, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Transfer the mushroom mixture to a baking dish.
Spread the cottage cheese mixture evenly over the top.
Dot the top with butter and sprinkle with milk.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
